relations.quote: The argument needs rings because a ring gives the arithmetic of the [arrays](array.md) used here: their entries are coefficients that are added and multiplied.
Residue rings appear in the [fast multiplication of Schönhage and Strassen](schonhage-strassen.md), where certain multiplications become shifts.
